title: Apply for the washing machine exchange program
summary: Find out if you are eligible and how to apply for the washing machine exchange program, which helps low-income households upgrade to an energy-efficient front-loading washing machine.
intro: The subsidy is helping low-income households to upgrade an inefficient top-loading washing machine with a water and energy efficient front-loading model.
who_can_apply: Hold a valid card from Centrelink or Department of Veteran Affairs
Have an existing top-loading washing machine to exchange
Not have participated in the washing machine exchange program in 2022 or 2025
what_you_need: An existing top-loading washing machine to exchange

### Information about the program

more_info.text: delivery and installation and removal of your old machine
Visit the NSW Government’s Washing Machine Exchange Program for more about:
For the latest information on the washing machine exchange program subscribe to email updates.
Note: Subscribing gives you email updates. It is not an application for a washing machine. You will still need to apply.

faqs.q: Who is eligible for the washing machine exchange program?
faqs.a: To be eligible, you must be a resident of NSW, over 18, hold a valid Centrelink or Department of Veteran Affairs card, have an existing top-loading washing machine to exchange, and not have participated in the program in 2022 or 2025.

faqs.q: Is a Commonwealth Seniors Health Card enough to apply?
faqs.a: No, a Commonwealth Seniors Health Card is not sufficient for this offer.

faqs.q: Where can I find more information about the program?
faqs.a: For questions about the washing machine exchange program, you can visit the Washing Machine Exchange Program page.
